items.heading: Fiskesuppe
details: Key ingredients: fish, cream, carrot, leek
Simmer a light fish stock with carrot and leek.
Add chunks of firm white fish and poach gently.
Stir in cream to enrich the soup.
Season lightly and serve hot with bread.

items.heading: Faarikaal
details: Key ingredients: lamb, cabbage, black peppercorns
Layer lamb pieces and cabbage wedges in a large pot.
Add whole black peppercorns between the layers.
Add a small amount of water and cover tightly.
Simmer slowly for hours until the lamb is fall-apart tender.
